purpose: Recommends optimal crops based on soil test NPK, pH, and local climatic conditions, adjusted by regional suitability and history-based crop rotation scoring.
output_format: Ranked list of recommended crops with blended final score (soil/climate, regional, rotation), nutrient status, and agronomic rationale
dataset_name: Crop Recommendation Dataset (ICAR / Indian Agricultural Benchmark)
known_limitations: Trained on 22 specific crop classes (rice, maize, chickpea, kidneybeans, pigeonpeas, mothbeans, mungbean, blackgram, lentil, pomegranate, banana, mango, grapes, watermelon, muskmelon, apple, orange, papaya, coconut, cotton, jute, coffee).
Soil-Test Primacy Invariant: Crop history adjusts rotation bonus/penalty but does not override current measured soil NPK deficiencies.
